analyticSelection: x = 1 + 100*(callbackUT-baseUT), y=z=0 AU. The source fixed-point map has approximate absolute derivative 100/C_AUDAY ~0.578; its finite alternating iterates remain below 2 AU. This parameter is chosen prospectively, not fit to measured traces.

reason: Original alternating fixture starts at zero distance and terminates successfully; preserve those original observations and add two separately identified requests.
